# 1. Charter the Karimi Red Sea Spice Guild (10-year renewal)

	decision_category = economy_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1337
		oe_pmam_is_host = yes
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmam_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		owns = location:cairo
		gold >= 180
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmam_karimi_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_karimi_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmam_dec_charter_karimi_guild.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmam_dec_charter_karimi_guild_tt
			add_gold = -180
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi_network_active value = 1 }
			oe_pmam_shift_karimi = { amount = 18 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_charter_mod years = 12 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Commission & expand Al-Tabaqa al-Khamisa Fifth Corps (up to tier 4)
oe_pmam_dec_commission_fifth_corps = {
	decision_category = government_decisions

	potential = {
		current_year >= 1437
		oe_pmam_is_host = yes
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }

			limit = { has_variable = oe_pmam_fifth_corps }

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmam_player_only_tt

		}
		is_subject = no

			text = oe_pmam_fifth_corps_tier_tt

				limit = { has_variable = oe_pmam_fifth_corps }
				var:oe_pmam_fifth_corps < 4
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmam_fifth_corps_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_fifth_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }

	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:nobles } }

}

oe_pmam_dec_abolish_iqta_farming = {
	decision_category = government_decisions

	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		current_year >= 1537
		oe_pmam_is_host = yes
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_iqta_reformed }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pmam_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		stability >= 15
		gold >= 350
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pmam_dec_abolish_iqta_farming.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pmam_dec_abolish_iqta_farming_tt
			add_gold = -350
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_iqta_reformed value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_salaried_army_mod years = 40 mode = replace }

				limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_pmam_ref_reformed_mamluk_army } }

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_12 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_12 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.12
			}
		}
	}
